name: RariCapital
fix_description: Add reentrancy protection to the withdrawal flow. The getBalance() function reads aETH.balanceOf which is not yet updated during a cross-contract reentrancy via ETH transfer callback. Use a nonReentrant modifier on withdrawal functions or update internal accounting before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a short but non-trivial multi-step exploit: flash-loan USDC, mint collateral, enter market, borrow ETH, then abuse the receive-hook/exitMarket interaction during ETH transfer to bypass collateral constraints before redeeming and repaying. It requires understanding Compound/Rari market mechanics and callback-based control flow, so it is more involved than an obvious single-pattern bug but not a deeply complex attack chain.
